verdict.rationale: Kintsugi is a sales-tax compliance API/SaaS product, not an AI agent or developer tool with telemetry that a user configures; the evidence pack contains no mention of telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out at all, and this axis is designed for AI-native tools/agents collecting usage data on the user's behalf rather than a tax compliance backend. This story is a category mismatch for the product type.
